options.content:
**How to use.** Each row below is one scenario's rate sweep: bars are the **median over repeats**
at each offered rate. Latency charts show mean (grey), p50 (light) and p99 (dark); p90/p95 are in the table. The table at the bottom lists every run; click a run name to open it in
**vLLM run detail** and watch load, batch size, queue depth, KV cache and latency change *during* the run.
Select several runs there to overlay them (sweep runs share an elapsed-time axis: 00:01:30 = 90 s in).

Every bar chart: **x-axis = offered load (requests per second)**, y-axis label and unit on each chart.
*completed* is steady-state throughput (requests finished inside the measured interval ÷ its length); when the
server keeps up it matches *offered*. Batch / queue / KV cache are vLLM's own gauges (`num_requests_running`,
`num_requests_waiting`, `kv_cache_usage_perc`), averaged over the measured interval. With two GPUs (P/D or
data parallel) they are summed over both, so KV cache used goes up to 200%.

panels.title: Throughput: offered vs completed (requests/s)
panels.description: If completed < offered, requests pile up in vLLM's queue: the server is past saturation.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, offered_rps_med AS offered, steady_requests_per_s_med AS completed FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, offered_rps_med AS offered, steady_requests_per_s_med AS completed FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Output throughput (tokens/s)
panels.description: Output tokens streamed inside the measured interval ÷ its length.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, steady_output_tokens_per_s_med AS [output tokens/s] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, steady_output_tokens_per_s_med AS [output tokens/s] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: vLLM batch and queue: mean number of requests

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_running_mean_med AS [batch (running)], srv_waiting_mean_med AS [queued (waiting)] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_running_mean_med AS [batch (running)], srv_waiting_mean_med AS [queued (waiting)] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: vLLM queue wait: mean (ms)
panels.description: Mean time from arriving at vLLM to first being scheduled (includes warmup requests).

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_queue_mean_ms_med AS [mean wait] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_queue_mean_ms_med AS [mean wait] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Time to first token: mean, p50, p99 (log scale)
panels.description: Arrival → first token. Queue wait + prefill.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, ttft_mean_ms_med AS mean, ttft_p50_ms_med AS p50, ttft_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, ttft_mean_ms_med AS mean, ttft_p50_ms_med AS p50, ttft_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Time per output token: mean, p50, p99 (ms/token)
panels.description: Per request: (e2e - ttft) / (tokens - 1), the average gap between its tokens.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, tpot_mean_ms_med AS mean, tpot_p50_ms_med AS p50, tpot_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, tpot_mean_ms_med AS mean, tpot_p50_ms_med AS p50, tpot_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Inter-token latency: mean, p50, p99 (ms)
panels.description: Every gap between two consecutive tokens of a request, pooled (≈ one engine step). p99 = decode stalls: a big prefill in the same step, or a preemption.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, itl_mean_ms_med AS mean, itl_p50_ms_med AS p50, itl_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, itl_mean_ms_med AS mean, itl_p50_ms_med AS p50, itl_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: End-to-end latency: mean, p50, p99 (log scale)
panels.description: Arrival → last token. Dominated by output length: compare within a scenario.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, e2e_mean_ms_med AS mean, e2e_p50_ms_med AS p50, e2e_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, e2e_mean_ms_med AS mean, e2e_p50_ms_med AS p50, e2e_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Normalized latency: mean, p50, p99 (ms per output token, log scale)
panels.description: e2e ÷ output tokens (the vLLM paper's metric); comparable across scenarios.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, norm_latency_mean_ms_med AS mean, norm_latency_p50_ms_med AS p50, norm_latency_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, norm_latency_mean_ms_med AS mean, norm_latency_p50_ms_med AS p50, norm_latency_p99_ms_med AS p99 FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: KV cache used: mean and max (%)
panels.description: Near 100% vLLM must preempt running requests.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_kv_cache_usage_mean_med * 100 AS mean, srv_kv_cache_usage_max_med * 100 AS max FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_kv_cache_usage_mean_med * 100 AS mean, srv_kv_cache_usage_max_med * 100 AS max FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Preemptions (count per run)
panels.description: Requests evicted for lack of KV blocks and recomputed later. > 0 = real KV-cache pressure.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_preemptions_med AS preemptions FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_preemptions_med AS preemptions FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Requests that waited > 1 s in vLLM's queue (%)
panels.description: From vLLM's queue-time histogram (includes warmup requests).

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, [srv_queue_frac_over_1.0s_med] * 100 AS [waited > 1 s] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, [srv_queue_frac_over_1.0s_med] * 100 AS [waited > 1 s] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate: new vs resumed requests (%)
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache. New requests: our prompts are random, so ~0 is expected. Resumed: how much of a preempted request's KV was still cached when it came back (the rest is recomputed). Resumed needs our vLLM fork's counters.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_prefix_cache_hit_rate_med * 100 AS [new requests], srv_resume_cache_hit_rate_med * 100 AS [resumed after preemption] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_prefix_cache_hit_rate_med * 100 AS [new requests], srv_resume_cache_hit_rate_med * 100 AS [resumed after preemption] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: Tokens re-queried by requests resuming after preemption
panels.description: Prompt + already generated tokens of preempted requests, looked up again when they resume. Times (1 - resumed hit rate) = tokens recomputed.

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_resume_tokens_med AS [tokens] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_resume_tokens_med AS [tokens] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: P/D: KV transfer time per request, mean (ms)
panels.description: Disaggregated prefill/decode only: NIXL time to move one request's KV cache from the prefill GPU to the decode GPU (decode server's vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds).

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_kv_xfer_mean_ms_med AS [mean transfer] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_kv_xfer_mean_ms_med AS [mean transfer] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: P/D: KV transfer bandwidth (GB/s)
panels.description: Bytes moved ÷ transfer time. Raw NVLink between these V100s measured ~45 GB/s (bench/nixl_check.py).

targets.queryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_kv_xfer_gb_per_s_med AS [bandwidth] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT printf('%g req/s', rate) AS rate, srv_kv_xfer_gb_per_s_med AS [bandwidth] FROM sweep_agg WHERE experiment = '$experiment' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY rate

panels.title: All runs (click a run to open it over time)

targets.queryText:
SELECT label AS run, scenario, rate AS [rate (req/s)], rep AS repeat,
  offered_rps AS [offered (req/s)], steady_requests_per_s AS [completed (req/s)],
  steady_output_tokens_per_s AS [output (tokens/s)],
  ttft_mean_ms AS [TTFT mean (ms)],
  ttft_p50_ms AS [TTFT p50 (ms)],
  ttft_p90_ms AS [TTFT p90 (ms)],
  ttft_p95_ms AS [TTFT p95 (ms)],
  ttft_p99_ms AS [TTFT p99 (ms)],
  tpot_mean_ms AS [TPOT mean (ms/token)],
  tpot_p50_ms AS [TPOT p50 (ms/token)],
  tpot_p90_ms AS [TPOT p90 (ms/token)],
  tpot_p95_ms AS [TPOT p95 (ms/token)],
  tpot_p99_ms AS [TPOT p99 (ms/token)],
  itl_mean_ms AS [ITL mean (ms)],
  itl_p50_ms AS [ITL p50 (ms)],
  itl_p90_ms AS [ITL p90 (ms)],
  itl_p95_ms AS [ITL p95 (ms)],
  itl_p99_ms AS [ITL p99 (ms)],
  e2e_mean_ms AS [E2E mean (ms)],
  e2e_p50_ms AS [E2E p50 (ms)],
  e2e_p90_ms AS [E2E p90 (ms)],
  e2e_p95_ms AS [E2E p95 (ms)],
  e2e_p99_ms AS [E2E p99 (ms)],
  norm_latency_mean_ms AS [norm. latency mean (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p50_ms AS [norm. latency p50 (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p90_ms AS [norm. latency p90 (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p95_ms AS [norm. latency p95 (ms/token)],
  norm_latency_p99_ms AS [norm. latency p99 (ms/token)],
  srv_running_mean AS [batch: mean running (requests)], srv_waiting_mean AS [queue: mean waiting (requests)],
  srv_waiting_max AS [queue: max waiting (requests)],
  srv_kv_cache_usage_mean * 100 AS [KV cache used, mean (%)], srv_kv_cache_usage_max * 100 AS [KV cache used, max (%)],
  srv_preemptions AS [preemptions (count)], srv_queue_mean_ms AS [vLLM queue wait, mean (ms)],
  [srv_queue_frac_over_1.0s] * 100 AS [waited > 1 s in vLLM queue (%)],
  srv_prefix_cache_hit_rate * 100 AS [prefix cache hit rate (%)],
  srv_resume_cache_hit_rate * 100 AS [resumed after preemption: KV still cached (%)],
  srv_kv_xfer_mean_ms AS [P/D KV transfer, mean (ms)], srv_kv_xfer_gb_per_s AS [P/D KV transfer (GB/s)],
  successes AS [completed (requests)], requests AS [sent (requests)], client_max_lag_ms AS [client max lag (ms)],
  run_id, experiment, from_ms, to_ms
FROM runs WHERE experiment = '$experiment'  ORDER BY mode, scenario, rate, rep
